classification.difficultyReason: Coordinate rooms, painters and time, recognising that more rooms increase time while more painters decrease it, then scale through painter-hours.

content.prompt: If 2 painters can paint 3 rooms in 9 hours, how long does it take for 3 painters to paint 4 rooms, working at the same rate?

answer.worked:
One painter takes twice as long as two painters to complete the same work.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Time for 1 painter to paint 3 rooms}&=2\times9=18\text{ hours}\\\text{Time for 1 painter to paint 1 room}&=18\div3=6\text{ hours}\\\text{Time for 1 painter to paint 4 rooms}&=6\times4=24\text{ hours}\\\text{Time for 3 painters to paint 4 rooms}&=24\div3=8\text{ hours}\end{align*}$$
